faq.title: Questions buyers and suppliers usually ask.

items.question: Do I need the Supplier Passport Setup?
items.answer: Supplier Passport Setup is an assisted setup add-on for Starter or Supplier Pro subscriptions. It helps structure your company profile, documents, and first Passport workspace.

items.question: Can I start with the VSME Passport Sprint only?
items.answer: Yes. The Sprint is a one-time package for companies that need to respond to one concrete buyer request before committing to a subscription.

items.question: What is the difference between Starter and Supplier Pro?
items.answer: Starter is limited to one user, one active Passport link and up to 15 documents. Supplier Pro adds up to 5 users, unlimited Passport links, up to 100 documents, Excel export, certificate reminders, buyer questionnaire workspace, audit trail and priority support.

items.question: Is this a certification or assurance report?
items.answer: No. Supplier Passport structures supplier-provided sustainability information and supporting evidence. It is not a certification, assurance report, or legal compliance opinion.

items.question: Can buyers access my documents?
items.answer: Only documents you approve for sharing are shown on buyer-facing share links. Internal notes and unapproved documents remain hidden.

items.question: Can consultants manage multiple clients?
items.answer: Yes. The Partner / Consultant plan is designed for ESG consultants, ISO consultants, accountants and advisors managing multiple SME clients.

items.question: Do you support buyer-side supplier tracking?
items.answer: Yes. Buyer Pilot and Buyer Pro are designed for companies that want to invite and monitor suppliers through a buyer dashboard.
